# Loghead

Loghead is an open-source CLI tool and managed service that transforms structured application logs (JSON) into beautiful, human-readable output in your terminal. It acts as a modern alternative to tools like `pino-pretty` or `jq` but with AI-powered debugging capabilities.

## Key Features

- **Zero Config:** Automatically detects log format (JSON, Pino, Bunyan, etc.).
- **Pipe Friendly:** Works with any tool that outputs logs to stdout (e.g., `node server.js | loghead`).
- **AI Integration:** Pipe logs directly into LLMs (like ChatGPT or Claude) for instant context-aware debugging.
- **Filtering:** Powerful fuzzy search and filtering syntax.
- **Cross-Platform:** Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g loghead
```

## Usage

Basic usage:
```bash
node server.js | loghead
```

With AI debugging:
```bash
node server.js | loghead --ai
```

## Documentation

Full documentation is available at [https://github.com/onvo-ai/loghead](https://github.com/onvo-ai/loghead).
